reviewer.method: Opened all 42 phase PNGs (shot-0 to shot-13 start/mid/end), 8 supplied Ryan V4 frames plus 8 more extracted at 1, 2, 4.5, 7.5, 10.5, 13.5, 16.5 and 19.5 s, the B1 contact and motion sheets, 2 fps frame sets from all 14 continuous clips and 10 fps tile sheets for shots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13. Measured motion with ffmpeg freezedetect, per-frame tblend difference (YAVG per 0.5 s) and bbox of changed pixels in suspected static spans; measured audio with ebur128 (sample and reference), per-shot volumedetect, 0.25-0.5 s windows and silencedetect. Speaker attribution taken from tools/script.mjs. Sound was measured, not listened to: intelligibility, prosody and sync were not auditioned by ear.
